old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jynf","title":"Slot-claim cap denominated in CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_SUPERFRAME_SEC but coordinator seeds duration_s from LICHEN_SUPERFRAME_DURATION_S (60) — dual source diverges","description":"Codereview finding on worker6-eaws (passes 2+3): coap_slot_coord.c:139 sets ctx-\u003esuperframe.duration_s = LICHEN_SUPERFRAME_DURATION_S (unconditional header define 60), while the new expiry cap (LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_MAX_DURATION_SEC) is derived from CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_SUPERFRAME_SEC (link/Kconfig, range 1-3600). If an integrator sets CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_SUPERFRAME_SEC=3600, the anti-squat cap silently becomes 5x3600s while superframe_id math still runs on 60s superframes - the 'N superframes' semantics mis-denominate. Help text documents the must-match invariant but nothing enforces it. Fix: initialize ctx-\u003esuperframe.duration_s from CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_SUPERFRAME_SEC (host fallback in coap_slot_coord.h already resolves to LICHEN_SUPERFRAME_DURATION_S=60, so host behavior is unchanged); verify no other consumer of LICHEN_SUPERFRAME_DURATION_S depends on the constant staying literal.
